Collection Description
# Notion REST API v1 (2025-09-03) — Blocks Module Automated Test Suite (Lab 03 Consolidated) **Author:** Karen Ivonne Cruz Alvarez (SQE III — Group 2) **Peer Reviewers (Lab 02 Audit):** Kiara Vanessa Muñoz Bayter (External Audit) & Gabriel Marcos Guaman Ortuño (Intra-Team Audit) **Target SUT:** Notion REST API `https://api.notion.com/v1` (`Notion-Version: 2025-09-03`) **Scope:** `Blocks` Module (`PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children`, `GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}`, `GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children`, `PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}`, `DELETE /v1/blocks/{block_id}`) + 4 Multi-Step E2E Workflows (`72` test cases / `81` HTTP requests across `6` folders). --- ## Step-by-Step Credential Provisioning & Environment Setup Guide Before executing this collection in Postman Collection Runner or Newman CLI (`v6.2.3`), import `Notion_Blocks_Env.postman_environment.json` and configure the following environment variables under **Current Value** (or pass via `--env-var`): 1. **`NOTION_TOKEN` (Required — Secret):** Internal Integration Bearer Secret (`ntn_...`) created at `https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations` with **Read content**, **Update content**, and **Insert content** capabilities enabled. 2. **`PARENT_PAGE_ID` / `PAGE_ID` (Required — UUIDv4):** The 32-char or 36-char UUID of a workspace root page explicitly shared with the integration via the page `•••` menu → **Connections**. Each test dynamically creates an isolated disposable child page (`QA sandbox - <TC_ID> - <timestamp>`) under `PARENT_PAGE_ID` and moves it to trash (`in_trash: true`) upon teardown. 3. **`NOTION_VERSION` (Required — Default `2025-09-03`):** Contractual Notion API version header automatically injected across requests. 4. **`READONLY_TOKEN` & `RESTRICTED_TOKEN` (Optional — Secret):** Secondary integration tokens configured without Insert/Update or Read capabilities to test `403 Forbidden` (`restricted_resource`) contracts. If left blank, dependent capability tests are cleanly skipped via `pm.execution.skipRequest()`. --- ## Unattended Newman CLI Execution Command ```bash npx newman run labs/lab03/postman/karen_cruz/Notion_Blocks_KarenCruz.postman_collection.json \ -e labs/lab03/postman/karen_cruz/Notion_Blocks_Env.postman_environment.json \ --delay-request 400 \ --timeout-script 600000 \ -r cli,htmlextra \ --reporter-htmlextra-export labs/lab03/reports/karen_cruz_newman_report.html ```
